description: Articulate house voice and advisory checks. The house voice is off until you turn it on with ARTICULATE_HOUSE_VOICE=on (or the Articulate command line, installed separately). When on, the model receives the house-voice brief at session start. After the model writes or edits a prose file, an advisory check names possible meaning changes and style findings and never blocks the edit. In mode revise only, the Stop hook reads the finished reply, and a reply that claims a human life or breaks a banned rule gets one revision request.
